decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Three year time limit

The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period expiring on 11/04/2028, when the use shall cease and the site restored to its former condition, as set out in the note below.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - In accordance with approved drawings and Documents
The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with:
Documents received on 12/11/2024
- GSK-HTL-SW-00-DR-A-10000 Rev P4 (Site Location Plan-East &West Car Park)
- GSK-HTL-SW-00-DR-A-10002 Rev P1 (Site Location Plan- Basement Car Park)
- GSK-HTL-SW-00-DR-A-10100 Rev P7 (Existing and Proposed Site Plan-- East and West Car Park) 
- GSK-HTL-SW-00-DR-A-10099 Rev P3 (Existing and Proposed Site Plan - Basement Car Park)
- Cover Letter dated 11/11/2024, by Turley  
Documents received on 08/04/2025
- Technical Note (TN04) dated April 2025, by Velocity 
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission, a satisfactory standard of development is secured, and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme.
Condition : 3 - Car parking provision Ref: P/2024/3768

The total car parking provision for the development shall not exceed the existing parking spaces, in accordance with the concurrent planning application Ref: P/2024/3766. 

Reason: To ensure that the level of car parking provision aligns with the approved transport assessment and to prevent excessive vehicle trips. 
Condition : 4 - Occupancy Restriction/ monitoring 

a. The number of occupiers in relation to the Site shall be limited to 4 tenants at any one time.  In the event that occupancy exceeds this limit, the Applicant shall notify the Local Planning Authority (LPA) in writing prior to the change taking place. 
 b. Monitoring of the actual number of delivery and servicing trips, with results to be reported annually to the council and the Delivery and Servicing Plan updated to ensure there are no impacts on the public highway. 

Reason: To ensure that the development does not result in an intensification of use beyond that assessed within the submitted transport assessment and to safeguard the amenity of surrounding residents and the operational capacity of the local highway network.   
Condition : 5 - HGV Access Restriction 

No Heavy Goods Vehicles (HGVs) associated with the development hereby permitted shall use the Boston Manor Road entrance. All HGVs shall only be access/exit the Site via the Great West Road access, in accordance with the supporting documents. 

Reason: To protect the safety and operation of the local highway network and ensure that vehicular access arrangements minimise conflicts with other road users and pedestrians.
description: Temporary change of use of the east and west surface and basement level car parks from ancillary car parking linked to the offices (E(g)(i)) to car park (sui generis) for a period of 3 years
subdivision_of_building: The proposals cover the east, west and basement car parks
